# `atlassian` command reference

<!-- Generated by tests/reference.rs from the clap definitions; do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate with: UPDATE_REFERENCE=1 cargo test --test reference -->

Every command only reads data (HTTP GET). Commands are
`atlassian <product> <resource> <action>`; run any of them with `--help` for the same
information.

## Global options

Accepted by every command, before or after it.

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--compact` | Print compact JSON instead of pretty-printed JSON |

## `jira`

Jira (issues, projects, users, search, ...)

### `atlassian jira server-info`

Server version and build information

No arguments or options.

### `atlassian jira myself`

The user whose credentials are in use

No arguments or options.

### `atlassian jira issue list`

List issues, filtered by project, people, status, type and dates

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--project <KEY>` | Only issues in this project key, e.g. `ABC`. Repeat for several (repeatable) |
| `--assignee <USER>` | Only issues assigned to this username, or `me` |
| `--reporter <USER>` | Only issues reported by this username, or `me` |
| `--status <STATUS>` | Only issues with this status, e.g. `In Progress`. Repeat for several (repeatable) |
| `--type <TYPE>` | Only issues of this type, e.g. `Bug`. Repeat for several (repeatable) |
| `--open` | Only unresolved issues |
| `--updated-since <PERIOD>` | Only issues updated within this period: a number and `m`, `h`, `d` or `w`, e.g. `7d` |
| `--created-since <PERIOD>` | Only issues created within this period, e.g. `30d` |
| `--order-by <ORDER_BY>` | Sort order (newest or highest first, except `key`) (default: `updated`; one of `updated`, `created`, `priority`, `key`) |
| `--fields <FIELDS>` | Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `summary,status,assignee` |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated entities to expand, e.g. `changelog` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian jira issue get`

Get an issue by key or id

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<KEY>` | Issue key or id, e.g. `ABC-123` |
| `--fields <FIELDS>` | Comma-separated fields to return |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated entities to expand, e.g. `changelog,renderedFields` |

| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |

| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

|---|---|

| `-q, --query <KEY=VALUE>` | Query parameter as key=value. Repeat for several parameters (repeatable) |

## `agile`

## `confluence`

Confluence (spaces, content, search, ...)

### `atlassian confluence space list`

List spaces

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--type <SPACE_TYPE>` | `global` or `personal` |
| `--key <KEYS>` | Only these space keys. Repeat for several (repeatable) |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `description.plain,homepage` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence space get`

Get a space by key

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<KEY>` | Space key, e.g. `DEV` (or `~username` for a personal space) |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `description.plain,homepage` |

### `atlassian confluence space content`

Content in a space

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<KEY>` | Space key, e.g. `DEV` (or `~username` for a personal space) |
| `--type <CONTENT_TYPE>` | Only content of this type (one of `page`, `blogpost`, `comment`, `attachment`) |
| `--depth <DEPTH>` | `all` (default) or `root` for top-level pages only |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence content list`

List content, optionally filtered by space, type and title

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--space <SPACE>` | Only content in this space key |
| `--type <CONTENT_TYPE>` | Only content of this type (one of `page`, `blogpost`, `comment`, `attachment`) |
| `--title <TITLE>` | Only content with exactly this title (combine with `--space`) |
| `--status <STATUS>` | `current` (default), `trashed`, `draft` or `any` |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `body.storage,version` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence content get`

Get content by id

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Content id (the `pageId` in a page's URL) |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `body.storage,version` |
| `--status <STATUS>` | Status to look for, e.g. `current` (default), `draft` or `trashed` |

### `atlassian confluence content children`

Direct children of a piece of content

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Content id (the `pageId` in a page's URL) |
| `--type <CONTENT_TYPE>` | Type of children to list (default: `page`; one of `page`, `blogpost`, `comment`, `attachment`) |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `body.storage,version` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence content descendants`

All descendants of a piece of content

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Content id (the `pageId` in a page's URL) |
| `--type <CONTENT_TYPE>` | Type of descendants to list (default: `page`; one of `page`, `blogpost`, `comment`, `attachment`) |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `body.storage,version` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence content comments`

Comments on a piece of content

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Content id (the `pageId` in a page's URL) |
| `--depth <DEPTH>` | `all` to include nested replies |
| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `body.storage,version` |

| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence content labels`

Labels on a piece of content

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Content id (the `pageId` in a page's URL) |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

History (creator, versions, contributors)

| `--expand <EXPAND>` | Comma-separated properties to expand, e.g. `contributors.publishers.users,previousVersion,nextVersion` |

No arguments or options.

|---|---|
| `--username <USERNAME>` | Username (login name), e.g. `alice` |
| `--key <KEY>` | User key (the stable id Confluence assigns to a user) |

### `atlassian confluence group list`

List groups

|---|---|
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence group members`

Members of a group

|---|---|
| `<NAME>` | Group name, e.g. `confluence-users` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian confluence raw`

GET any Confluence REST path

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | Path below the base URL, starting with `/`: e.g. `/rest/api/2/serverInfo` (Jira), `/rest/api/space` (Confluence) or `/rest/api/latest/projects` (Bitbucket) |
| `-q, --query <KEY=VALUE>` | Query parameter as key=value. Repeat for several parameters (repeatable) |

## `bitbucket`

Bitbucket (projects, repositories, pull requests, ...)

### `atlassian bitbucket application-properties`

Version and build information

No arguments or options.

### `atlassian bitbucket project list`

List projects

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <NAME>` | Only projects whose name contains this text |
| `--permission <PERMISSION>` | Only projects where the user has this permission, e.g. `PROJECT_READ` |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket project get`

Get a project by key

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<KEY>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |

### `atlassian bitbucket repo list`

List repositories, in one project or across all projects

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `[PROJECT]` | Only repositories in this project |
| `--name <NAME>` | Only repositories whose name contains this text |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket repo get`

Get a repository

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |

### `atlassian bitbucket branch list`

List branches

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |
| `--filter <FILTER>` | Only branches whose name contains this text |
| `--order-by <ORDER_BY>` | `ALPHABETICAL` or `MODIFICATION` |
| `--details` | Include ahead/behind and latest-commit metadata |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket branch default`

|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |

|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |

Commits in a pull request

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |
| `<ID>` | Pull request id (the number in its URL) |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket file list`

List file paths, recursively, below a directory

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |
| `[PATH]` | Directory to list (default: repository root) |
| `--at <AT>` | Commit or ref to list at |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket file browse`

Browse a directory (children) or file (lines) as JSON

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |
| `[PATH]` | File or directory path (default: the repository root) |
| `--at <AT>` | Commit or ref to read at, e.g. `refs/heads/main` (default: the default branch) |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket file content`

Print the raw content of a file

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PROJECT>` | Project key, e.g. `PROJ` (or `~username` for a personal project) |
| `<REPO>` | Repository slug |
| `<PATH>` | File path, e.g. `src/main.rs` |
| `--at <AT>` | Commit or ref to read at, e.g. `refs/heads/main` (default: the default branch) |

### `atlassian bitbucket user list`

List users

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--filter <FILTER>` | Only users whose username, name or email contains this text |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket user get`

Get a user by slug

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<SLUG>` | User slug (usually the username), e.g. `alice` |

### `atlassian bitbucket group list`

List groups

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--filter <FILTER>` | Only groups whose name contains this text |
| `--start <START>` | Index of the first result to return |
| `--limit <LIMIT>` | Maximum number of results per page |
| `--all` | Follow pagination and print every result as one JSON array |

### `atlassian bitbucket raw`

GET any Bitbucket REST path

| Argument / option | Description |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | Path below the base URL, starting with `/`: e.g. `/rest/api/2/serverInfo` (Jira), `/rest/api/space` (Confluence) or `/rest/api/latest/projects` (Bitbucket) |
| `-q, --query <KEY=VALUE>` | Query parameter as key=value. Repeat for several parameters (repeatable) |
